title: Yoisaki Kanade — The Dream I Saw Will One Day〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Dream I Saw Will One Day（4★）

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, this works...
I'll do the rest on my end.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<We had so many fixes this time.
Yawn... Time for some well-earned rest.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, stop...! Before you all go, let's decide when we're gonna have our party!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What, already? You know it's not actually done yet, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, before we all forget♪ How does tomorrow sound? Maybe after Yuki gets out of cram school?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Tomorrow's the anniversary of my mother passing away.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then we should have our party some other time...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, I need to get everything ready for tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Incense, a lighter and...
Gloves, garbage bags and cleaning supplies...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad supposedly made this song because what he saw with mom on one their trips was too beautiful to forget...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They showed me some photos when I was little, but I can't really remember what they were of...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Those photos could still be in an album somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I found some albums, but no luck. They could still be hidden away somewhere else...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Looking for them might take a while...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should wrap things up with our song first. I need to come up with a demo for the next song too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I probably only have until morning at the latest.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's exactly as I imagined it too. Except the outro. I still have a few options left there...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'd like to ask everyone what they think, but I really doubt any of them will be up at this time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anyone else that I can...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's something bright over there. I wonder if that's Miku and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But what's this? A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's about the size of an apple. Where did this come from? It's too bright and hard to tell what's actually creating this light...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (More and more things have been appearing here lately, but nothing like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This place is made out of Mafuyu's feelings, so this could be another part of her as well...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It doesn't seem hot. Maybe I can touch it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
A field of flowers?
But I was in SEKAI just now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is this the same SEKAI...?
I've never seen this place before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't see Miku or anyone else here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hold on... If I stop Untitled, maybe it'll send me back to my room...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I don't have a choice. I'll just have to keep looking for everyone here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know where this is, but I hope I can get back somehow...)
